overview.description: The Simplify Chinese Commodities Strategy No K-1 ETF (CCOM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad market commodities. The fund is actively managed, seeking capital appreciation by targeting futures contracts on Chinese commodities, making use of long/short models, anticipated to perform positively during inflationary periods. CCOM was launched on Jan 26, 2026 and is issued by Simplify.
